What is the difference between Quelli and Quei? : r/italianlearning
s: October 29, 2019 - Quelli means "those ones", so you can use it in place of a noun. Quei means "those" and is followed by a noun. Just like in English, where you can say "I want to buy those books" ("voglio comprare quei libri") or can also say "I want to buy those ones" ("voglio comprare quelli").
